subject: Rollout decision queue & docs sprint request
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, sara.cho@acme.com, aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Rollout decision queue & docs sprint request

Team –

We're getting close on the Acme integration activation window (targeting 11/28), and there are three cross-functional asks I need action and decisions on this week so we can lock the rollout lane:

1) Exception queue: attached is a lightweight exception log (launch-exception-log.xlsx). Please mark any blocking exceptions you own and indicate ETA for a fix or a mitigation. We need binary go / no-go flags for items tagged P0 by EOD Mon 11/13.

2) Docs sprint: the customer-facing runbook + internal runplay need a 2-day content sprint to close gaps. Priyom, can your team own the sprint and deliver the doc draft by 11/15? Linked doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-launch-doc-sprint

3) Rollout sequencing: Vivek, we have 2 rollout lanes (gradual by tenant vs. region burst). Need your recommendation on default lane and an exception path if the performance SLO at scale degrades.

Quick asks in-thread only — we'll run a short 30-min sync if we can't resolve by EOD Mon.

Attachments: launch-exception-log.xlsx, docs-sprint-outline.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Launch Ops
Redwood Inference

----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, sara.cho@acme.com
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rollout decision queue & docs sprint request

Marissa —

Thanks for the call-out. Quick clarifying question on the exception sheet: the block labelled "staging GPU capacity mismatch" — is that a hard blocker for the tenant-gradual lane, or only for the burst lane? If the former, I'll flag as P0 and we should consider the region-burst as fallback.

Also +1 for the docs sprint. Happy to allocate two technical writers for the 11/14–11/15 window if Priyom confirms ownership.

-Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Developer Enablement
Redwood Inference

----
On Thu, Nov 9, 2028 at 10:37 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Laura —
> 
> Short answer: the staging GPU capacity mismatch is a blocker for the region-burst lane (we rely on pooled GPU instances to get parallelism), but it's *not* a showstopper for the tenant-gradual lane because the gradual path keeps requests within smaller slices and we can rate-limit per-tenant to keep latency within SLOs.
> 
> Recommendation: default to tenant-gradual for the 11/28 activation, with a triggered escalation to region-burst only after automated health checks (RLW-4127) pass at 75% of expected traffic over a 2-hour window. Fallback plan: auto-failover to a lower-capacity model variant plus an informative customer banner.
> 
> I'll add the health-check thresholds to the ops runbook and sign off once Priyom's doc sprint finishes so the runbook references the final rollback scripts.
> 
> Vivek
> Principal Infrastructure PM
> Redwood Inference

----
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Nov 2028 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rollout decision queue & docs sprint request

Marissa —

We can run the docs sprint. Commit: 11/14–11/15 for the content sprint, deliverable is the draft runbook + internal play (PDF + Google doc). I'll coordinate writers that Laura suggested. I'll also add a simple checklist for the exception owners to confirm mitigations:

- Confirm fix or mitigation (yes/no)
- Target ETA (date)
- Temporary workaround (if any)
- Owners for verification after deploy

I'm attaching the sprint outline (docs-sprint-outline.pdf) with proposed roles. I will update the Google doc throughout the sprint and ping the thread when the draft is ready for review.

Priyom Das
Manager, Content & Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: docs-sprint-outline.pdf

----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, sara.cho@acme.com
Cc: aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 13 Nov 2028 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rollout decision queue & docs sprint request

Marissa —

A few compliance notes before we finalize the runbook:

- SOC2 evidence: Acme asked for a short list of audit artifacts we’ll provide at activation (auth logs, retention policy excerpt, network diagram). I can assemble those if Acme confirms the specific artifacts.
- Data residency: confirm the region for customer data processing (us-west-2 vs us-east-1) so I can populate the checklist.
- Marketplace listing: AWS asked us to include the marketplace activation steps in external docs — I've cc'd aws-marketplace-sales to keep them in the loop.

If Acme (Sara) can confirm data-region and the minimal SOC2 artifacts, I’ll queue the compliance packet.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, sara.cho@acme.com, aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 13 Nov 2028 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rollout decision queue & docs sprint request

Thanks everyone — good progress. Quick summary and next steps: 

- Decision lane: default = tenant-gradual (per Vivek). Region-burst is fallback after RLW-4127 health checks.
- Exceptions: owners, please update the attached spreadsheet with go/no-go flags by EOD Tue 11/14.
- Docs sprint: Priyom will run 11/14–11/15; draft due COB 11/15. Laura's writers + Priyom's team.
- Compliance: Sara (Acme) to confirm data-region and SOC2 list; Kimberly will produce the packet once confirmed.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync Wed 11/15 only if any P0s remain untriaged. Otherwise we'll proceed to final activation prep.

Marissa
Senior Product Manager, Launch Ops
Redwood Inference

----
Attachments referenced as stubs: launch-exception-log.xlsx (spreadsheet stub: columns [id, owner, severity, description, go_flag, eta]), docs-sprint-outline.pdf (PDF stub: 2 pages, roles & timeline)
